mapper.sql: select g.grant_id, g.user_id, g.phone_snapshot, g.client_desc, g.status, g.expire_time, g.last_used_time, g.create_time, g.update_time, g.remark, u.user_name, u.phonenumber, d.dept_name from edop_connector_grant g left join sys_user u on u.user_id = g.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id
mapper.select:
where g.del_flag = '0'
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND g.status = #{status}
order by g.last_used_time desc
where g.del_flag = '0' and g.user_id = #{userId} order by g.create_time desc

select g.grant_id, g.user_id, g.grant_token_hash, g.phone_snapshot, g.client_desc, g.status, g.expire_time, g.last_used_time, g.create_time, g.update_time, g.remark, g.del_flag, u.user_name, u.phonenumber, d.dept_name from edop_connector_grant g left join sys_user u on u.user_id = g.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where g.grant_token_hash = #{grantTokenHash} and g.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update edop_connector_grant set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where grant_id = #{grantId}
update edop_connector_grant set last_used_time = sysdate(), expire_time = #{expireTime}, update_time = sysdate() where grant_id = #{grantId}
